Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 119 aliases, and each one needs its own funded vine account. A bond of 41% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Scaling to 883 identities multiplies that fee by 305 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
